posts.title: AI pasted on a surface
posts.description: This is Leo's idea for covering the front wall of the new room. All is real here except the brick-ey surface and the planter, which could never come all the way out to the street. The surface may stay, we'll see.

posts.title: When change yanks your chain
posts.description: Life throws you for a loop, they say, and say correctly. We never know from one day to the next what might happen. We makes our plans, which may be easily and quickly interrupted. Routine can get quickly broken. Mine got upturned last week. The Missus's accident Sunday week ago stopped most everything.
